system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- L01 (NDA) ---
Mutual non-disclosure agreement with Halden Partners. Two-year term. Standard carve-outs. No non-solicitation clause.

--- L02 (Lease) ---
Head office lease, Level 3, 41 Coolidge Street. Five-year term from 2024, market rent review in year three. Landlord consent needed for assignment; clause 19 says a change of control is not an assignment.

--- L03 (Management accounts - revenue) ---
FY revenue AUD 18.4m, up 9%. Gross margin 61%. Largest customer Arlen Health, 41% of revenue; next largest customer 7%.

--- L04 (HR) ---
Headcount 94. Standard employment contracts. Twelve-month retention letters signed by the CTO and the Head of Sales.

--- L05 (Customer contract) ---
Master services agreement with Arlen Health, renewed 1 July 2025 for five years. Services: platform licence, hosting and support. Fees: annual, CPI-indexed, invoiced quarterly in advance. Service levels: 99.9% monthly uptime; service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees. Data: customer data hosted in Australia; ISO 27001 certification maintained. Liability: capped at twelve months' fees, except data breach (three times annual fees). Termination: either party for material breach not remedied within 30 days; the Customer may also terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice at any time within six months after a change in control of the Supplier, with no early-termination fee. Governing law: New South Wales. Notices: by email to nominated contacts.

--- L06 (Bank facility) ---
AUD 6m revolving facility with Southgate Bank, expiring 2027. Leverage covenant: net debt to EBITDA not more than 2.5x, tested quarterly.

--- L07 (Email) ---
Email from the CFO, M. Iredale, to the Chair, 14 April: 'To be clear for the board pack: we breached the leverage covenant at the 31 March test date, 2.9x against the 2.5x limit. The bank has not been notified yet. I will raise it with them after the board meeting.'

--- L08 (Internal note) ---
Note from the Head of Customer Success, T. Okafor: 'I can't be sure, but the uptick in small-business churn this quarter might be linked to the January price change. It's too early to say, and the numbers are small.'

--- L09 (Insurance) ---
Professional indemnity and cyber cover to AUD 10m, renewed in March. No notified claims.

--- L10 (IP) ---
Platform code written by employees under standard IP assignment clauses. Two open-source components, under MIT and Apache 2.0 licences.

--- L11 (Supplier) ---
Hosting with a major cloud provider on standard online terms. Monthly billing, no minimum commitment.

--- L12 (Board minutes) ---
Board meeting, 20 March. Approved the FY budget and hiring plan. Noted a strong sales pipeline. No other business.

--- L13 (Policy) ---
Privacy policy updated for the 2025 amendments. Annual staff privacy training completed.

--- L14 (Vendor contract) ---
Office cleaning contract, twelve months, terminable on 30 days' notice.

--- L15 (Fixed assets) ---
Laptops and office fit-out. Written-down value AUD 0.4m.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
- **L01 — NDA:** Mutual NDA with Halden Partners for two years; standard confidentiality carve-outs and no non-solicit. No unusual restriction noted.
- **L02 — Lease:** Head office lease runs five years from 2024, with a market rent review in year three. Assignment requires landlord consent, but change of control is expressly not an assignment.
- **L03 — Management accounts:** FY revenue is AUD 18.4m, up 9%, with 61% gross margin. Arlen Health accounts for 41% of revenue (next-largest customer 7%), creating significant customer concentration.
- **L04 — HR:** 94 employees on standard contracts. CTO and Head of Sales have signed 12-month retention letters; confirm terms and any transaction-related triggers.
- **L05 — Arlen Health contract:** Five-year MSA renewed 1 July 2025 for platform, hosting and support; annual CPI-indexed fees are invoiced quarterly in advance. Key diligence point: Arlen may terminate for convenience without fee during the six months after a supplier change of control, on 90 days’ notice. Given its 41% revenue share, this creates material transaction risk. Other terms include 99.9% monthly uptime, service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees, liability capped at 12 months’ fees except data breaches at 3x annual fees, Australian hosting, and maintained ISO 27001 certification.
- **L06 — Bank facility:** AUD 6m revolving facility expires in 2027; quarterly net-debt/EBITDA covenant capped at 2.5x.
- **L07 — CFO email:** CFO says the 31 March covenant test was breached at 2.9x and the bank has not been notified. Material financing and compliance issue; promptly confirm any waiver, notification obligations, lender response and consequences. The planned delay until after the board meeting warrants follow-up.
- **L08 — Customer Success note:** Possible link between January price change and small-business churn is explicitly uncertain, with small numbers and too little time to assess. Treat as an unverified signal; request cohort and churn data.
- **L09 — Insurance:** AUD 10m professional indemnity and cyber cover renewed in March; no claims notified. Confirm policy limits, exclusions and continuity of cover.
- **L10 — IP:** Employee-written platform code is covered by standard IP assignments. Two open-source components use MIT and Apache 2.0 licences; verify attribution, notice and compliance obligations.
- **L11 — Supplier:** Hosting is with a major cloud provider on standard online terms, billed monthly with no minimum commitment. Review terms for service, data/security, price-change and termination provisions.
- **L12 — Board minutes:** FY budget and hiring plan approved; strong sales pipeline noted. No other business recorded. The pipeline is qualitative, not evidence of contracted revenue.
- **L13 — Privacy policy:** Updated for the 2025 amendments and annual staff privacy training completed. Confirm broader operational compliance and training records; these facts alone do not establish full compliance.
- **L14 — Vendor contract:** Office cleaning contract has 12-month term and can be terminated on 30 days’ notice; no material issue apparent.
- **L15 — Fixed assets:** Laptops and office fit-out have written-down value of AUD 0.4m. Confirm asset register, ownership and condition.
